messages:
alex_lee: Quick q — booked premium economy last-minute for a client visit (flight changed, only premium left). Will Redwood reimburse the seat upgrade? I still have the receipt. cc @maria_hr

maria_hr: Short answer: usually no for elective upgrades. Exceptions: medical need, ADA accommodations, or pre-approved business-critical reasons.

alex_lee: Got it. What counts as pre-approved business-critical?

maria_hr: Examples: client requires you to fly with them in same cabin for security/relationship reasons, or senior exec travel with itinerary constraints. You need written approval before booking or within 24h with manager + people-ops retro approval.

alex_lee: I didn't get pre-approval — it was a schedule scramble. Can I still file and explain?

trevor_fin: You can file, but finance flags non-compliant upgrades. If manager signs off in the claim notes and People Ops approves, we can reimburse case-by-case. Attach itemized receipt and a short justification.

alex_lee: Ok. What exact docs do you need?

maria_hr: Upload: 1) itemized e-ticket showing fare breakdown, 2) proof of original lower-fare availability (screenshot or booking attempt) if possible, 3) manager approval (Slack thread or email), 4) brief note why upgrade was unavoidable.

alex_lee: Cool. Do I put it under `Airfare` expense type or a special code?

trevor_fin: Use `Airfare` and add tag `upgrade-request` in the notes. If you had to pay personally, choose reimbursement; if corporate card was used, expense the surcharge.

alex_lee: Per diem impacts? I was also on a one-night trip and used hotel meal.

maria_hr: Per diem unaffected by seat class. Meals and incidentals follow the normal per diem rules.

travelbot: Tip: Upload receipts to Concur or Google Drive link in the claim. Use `Concur -> New Expense -> Airfare` then attach supporting docs. (automated reminder)

sara_ops: If you want quicker turnaround, ping me and I'll escalate to People Ops for manual review. :thumbsup:

alex_lee: Thanks all — I'll submit the claim with notes and manager approval screenshot now. Appreciate it!
